symptom: A data view over TWO associations from a page parameter cannot be written: the short form describe printed (`$Order/Mod.A1/Mod.A2`) builds CE1613 "The selected entity 'Mod.A2' no longer exists"; the full form (`$Order/A1/E1/A2/E2`) passes `check -p --references` and leaves the project **unloadable**: "An error occurred when trying to set the 'DestinationEntity' property of a Entity ref step in a Page" ---> ArgumentNullException
cause: The `association` datasource case split the path at its FIRST `/` (assoc + everything else as the destination), and both association writers (`dataViewContextAssociationSourceToGen`, `associationSourceToGen`) did `SplitN(path, "/", 2)` into exactly one EntityRefStep. Short form: the second association became DestinationEntity. Full form: DestinationEntity was the literal "E1/A2/E2", which Mendix resolves to null
insight: The multi-step shape did not need a Studio Pro reference: one `{Association, DestinationEntity}` EntityRefStep per hop is already read from Studio Pro-authored List View sources (`parseEntityPathSource`) and written by `entityRefToGen`/`attributeEntityRefBSON` — check the codebase's own readers before declaring a BSON shape unknown. Classify each segment after an association by asking 'is it an association?' (then it is the next hop) rather than by parity, so `A1/A2`, `A1/E1/A2/E2` and mixtures all build; an explicit destination must be an end (or specialization of an end) of its association, which also catches a misspelled second association that would otherwise be read as an entity. Describe printed associations only, which for >1 hop re-derives every destination — print each stored destination instead. A/B on pedapp (11.13): pre-fix binary -> mx check dies loading the project; fixed -> no errors on the new pages. Repro `mdl-examples/bug-tests/1467-dataview-two-hop-association-source.mdl`. mendixlabs/mxcli#1467
